description: Six Classic/H3-director packages; identical role/toolkit/H3 technical reference; only one concise creative_addendum differs. D is frozen.

packages.hypothesis: Existing Classic plus H3 toolkit is sufficient.
The direct specialist-origin cue 'exceptionally thorough and specific' improves output without detailed instructions.
packages.creative_addendum: Be exceptionally thorough and specific about the visuals that will actually be rendered.

packages.hypothesis: Complete definitions and confident authoring of unspecified details outperform a general thoroughness cue.
packages.creative_addendum: Fully describe each intended visual element when it first appears in a Scene: its complete visible appearance, location, spatial relationships, and starting physical state. Make concrete choices for unspecified details. Carry each definition through later shots, describing intended changes where they happen.

packages.hypothesis: Clarifying the overview/invariants/standalone Scene relationships improves relevant continuity without imposing permanent restrictions.
packages.creative_addendum: Use the Project overview as a creative map and Invariants as a recurring baseline. Each Scene stands alone and fully specifies its intended image and sound. Carry forward relevant established details and define intentional changes within the Scene.

packages.hypothesis: Clear element selection plus full description helps without reducing the desired scene's ambition or number of people.
packages.creative_addendum: Choose coherent, readily distinguishable visual elements suited to the Scene's ambition. Define each chosen element concretely and completely; keep recurring identities stable and give incidental elements detail appropriate to their role.

packages.hypothesis: A short synthesis of the most relevant principles outperforms individual cues without unnecessary prompt bloat.
packages.creative_addendum: Choose and describe every intended visual element comprehensively when first introduced. Make definite creative choices for unspecified details. Use established Project details as a baseline, carrying relevant identities and physical states into each independently generated Scene; describe changes as they occur.
